```text
backdown mirror [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>
```

## backdown mirror add {#add}

Start mirroring FOLDER into MIRROR (a folder on another drive)

```text
backdown mirror add [OPTIONS] <FOLDER> <MIRROR>
```

### Arguments

`<FOLDER>`
: The folder to keep copied, usually part of the archive.

`<MIRROR>`
: Where the copy goes: a folder on another drive. Neither folder may be inside the other.

### Options

`--verify-every <VERIFY_EVERY>`
: Re-read a sample of the mirror every this many days. Default: `30`.

## backdown mirror list {#list}

Mirrors, and how they were when last synced and verified.

```text
backdown mirror list [OPTIONS]
```

## backdown mirror sync {#sync}

Copy what's new or changed (old copies are kept aside; nothing is deleted)

```text
backdown mirror sync [OPTIONS] [ID]
```

### Arguments

`[ID]`
: A mirror's number from `backdown mirror list`. Without it, every mirror.

## backdown mirror verify {#verify}

Re-read files on the mirror and compare them with the source.

```text
backdown mirror verify [OPTIONS] [ID]
```

### Arguments

`[ID]`
: A mirror's number from `backdown mirror list`. Without it, every mirror.

### Options

`--percent <PERCENT>`
: Share of the files to re-read (a different share each day). Default: `5`.

`--all`
: Re-read every file.

## backdown mirror remove {#remove}

Stop keeping a mirror (the copies stay where they are)

```text
backdown mirror remove [OPTIONS] <ID>
```

### Arguments

`<ID>`
: A mirror's number from `backdown mirror list`.

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

A sync never deletes: when a file changed, the mirror's old copy is moved to `.backdown-versions/` in the mirror first, and files that exist only on the mirror are kept and counted. The daemon syncs each mirror daily and re-reads a sample on its schedule, whenever both drives are connected.

## Examples

```sh
backdown mirror add /media/archive/Archive/Mail /media/backup/Mail
backdown mirror list
backdown mirror sync
backdown mirror verify 1 --all
backdown mirror remove 1
```
